claims.explanation: The problem asks for f applied five times, f(f(f(f(f(1))))), but this expression has only four applications of f.
This uses -2 as the value of f(1), but since 1 >= 0, f(1) = -(1)^2 = -1, so the first composition should become f(f(f(f(-1)))).
This line asserts f(6) = -30, but since 6 >= 0, f(6) = -(6)^2 = -36, not -30.
This line asserts f(-30) = -38, but since -30 < 0, f(-30) = -30 + 8 = -22, not -38.
